description: This file implements authentication endpoints for a FastAPI application, including user registration, login, and profile retrieval. It handles user credential validation, token creation, and user lookup.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_username(db: Session, username: str)
methods.description: Fetches a User object from the database matching the provided username.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_email(db: Session, email: str)
methods.description: Fetches a User object from the database matching the provided email address.

methods.name: Optional[User] authenticate_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies the user's credentials and returns the User object if valid.

methods.name: User get_current_user( token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user based on the provided Bearer token.

methods.name: register_user(payload: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with email, username, and password.

methods.name: login_for_access_token( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Endpoint for user login, returning a JWT token upon successful authentication.

methods.name: read_profile(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the profile of the current authenticated user.

ctags.name: authenticate_user
ctags.pattern: /^def authenticate_user(db: Session, username: str, password: str) -> Optional[User]:$/

ctags.name: get_current_user
ctags.signature: ( token: Annotated[str, Depends(oauth2_scheme)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], )

ctags.name: login_for_access_token
ctags.signature: ( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
